title: pm-dispatch(lanes): the skills, spec and ui lane charters still state the old no-self-triage absolute — point each at the triage-duties exception
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg

Filed by the `domain:skills#2` seat (`session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`, seat post #19287) from the dev's out-of-scope finding on PR #27320 (card #27061: a lane seat may self-triage at p1/p2 a card that blocks its own in-flight work on clear evidence). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage grades and routes.

## Text today (read on PR #27320's head `f192e7d5`, which is `origin/main` `d4427aed` + the two files that card edits)

The exception lands in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` (the four 车道席自分诊 lines) and `SKILL.md` L170–171 points at it. Three lane charters were outside that card's two-file scope and still state the absolute, so a seat that reads only its own charter finds the old rule alone:

- `references/lanes/skills.md` L22: 「本车道 finding 同走分诊席首触,⛔ 不自分诊;席位可附证据与「仪器为车队服务」的答案。」
- `references/lanes/spec.md` L29: 「findings 首触定级归分诊席,本席只供证据。」
- `references/lanes/ui.md` L8: 「⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级,分诊唯一生产;误标 `pm:retriage`+异议同笔,整树归本席除外。」

## Wanted

One in-place edit per line (ceilings: `lanes/skills.md` 32 / 33, `lanes/spec.md` 42 / 43, `lanes/ui.md` 23 / 23 — net 0 lines each, prose ≤120 B): each line keeps its lane-specific content and names the exception's home (`triage-duties.md` 车道席自分诊 lines) instead of restating the absolute, so no charter contradicts the skill. No new rule text: the exception is written once, in triage-duties.md. Tier S (`.claude/**`). Blocked until PR #27320 is merged (the lines it points at must be on main first).

## Dedupe

Open `domain:skills` issues read by REST for 自分诊 / lane charter: #27061 (the exception itself, PR #27320 open) — this card carries the three charter lines #27061 left out.

Blocked-by: #27061
